ModStmGrotesque.name: Grotesque
ModStmGrotesque.special: Turn to stone: no harm; hits return as shards
passive: First killing blow: crumble to rubble, then reform
with some health. Your ember ring shows it is still to come
ModStmGrotesque.vault: A gargoyle that turns to stone, then spits the hits it took back as shards

ModStmSixfold.name: Sixfold Idol
ModStmSixfold.attack: A random weapon a swing: sword, mace, spear, flail
ModStmSixfold.special: A rite of jade: Ring, Fan, Spiral or Cross
passive: Your next rite's sigil glows over you when ready.
All four rites come once before any of them repeats
ModStmSixfold.vault: A six-armed temple idol. Each hand holds a different weapon

ModStmGambit.name: Gambit
ModStmGambit.attack: Rear up and slam your head down
passive: A landing on the hero puts him in check.
Slam him while in check for checkmate
ModStmGambit.vault: A knight from a giant's chessboard. It has never once moved in a straight line

ModStmCaryatid.name: Caryatid
ModStmCaryatid.attack: Smash your stone capital down in front
ModStmCaryatid.special: Raise a column under the hero; it stands a while
passive: Beside one of your columns you take less damage.
Two columns at most; the oldest crumbles first
ModStmCaryatid.vault: A temple maiden who held up a roof for a thousand years. She has columns to spare

ModStmLachrymosa.name: Lachrymosa
ModStmLachrymosa.special: Lights Out: the room goes dark; none see you
passive: Watched, you turn to slow stone
Unseen, you are swift and fierce
ModStmLachrymosa.vault: A weeping angel from the last gallery. She moves when nobody is looking at her
